name: Next Event
author: Plinth
description: The next thing on your calendar and a live countdown to it, straight from an ICS link — no OAuth, no account connection. Handles daily and weekly repeats.

properties.name: icsUrl
properties.label: Private ICS link
properties.placeholder: The secret iCal address from your calendar's sharing settings
properties.help: The private iCal address of the calendar, not its web page. Google Calendar: Settings for that calendar → "Secret address in iCal format". Outlook: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish, then take the ICS link. Stored as a secret because anyone holding it can read the whole calendar.
